scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && python3 scripts/check_foundation.py && npm run test:tooling
scripts.lint: ruff check scripts tests/tooling && eslint . && python3 scripts/check_application.py
scripts.test:tooling: PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests/tooling -v && python3 -m coverage report && python3 -m coverage xml
scripts.check:rust: mkdir -p coverage && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked --message-format=json -- -D warnings > coverage/clippy.json
scripts.test:unit: cargo test --locked -p commerce-domain -p commerce-application && python3 scripts/test_money_mutation.py && vitest run
scripts.test:migrations: python3 scripts/with_postgres.py -- cargo test --locked -p commerce-infrastructure --test postgres -- --exact prior_schema_upgrade_preserves_old_reader_and_data
scripts.test:coverage: cargo llvm-cov clean && python3 scripts/with_postgres.py -- cargo llvm-cov --workspace --all-features --locked --json --output-path coverage/rust-stable.json && cargo +nightly-2026-10-25 llvm-cov clean && python3 scripts/with_postgres.py -- cargo +nightly-2026-10-25 llvm-cov --workspace --all-features --locked --branch --json --output-path coverage/rust.json && cargo +nightly-2026-10-25 llvm-cov report --lcov --output-path coverage/rust.lcov && vitest run --coverage && python3 scripts/check_coverage_reports.py
scripts.test:browser: python3 scripts/with_postgres.py -- node tests/application/serve.mjs e2e accessibility security discovery performance visual
